name: Super Vadimka VI: A Terrible Threat there is No Vadimka
summary: Super Vadimka VI: A Terrible Threat There is No Vadimka is an action platformer with horror elements, created by Kulevx released on January 5, 2023, for Windows. In this sixth installment of the Super Vadimka series, players follow the exploits of Vadim Kulev, an infamous figure from Velizh who has gained legendary status. The game boasts a retro 16-bit aesthetic reminiscent of SNES classics, featuring around 100 levels filled with challenging, bloodthirsty bosses that embody the disturbing Kulechkophobia virus that plagues the protagonist.
